about.title: About this game: how it deals with history
about.1: This is a strategy game about the Second World War in Europe, North Africa and the Middle East from 1 September 1939. It shows the war as armies, industry and supply on a map. You can play any country, Germany included, which began this war. To play a country is not to approve of what it did.
about.2: The game leaves out a great deal. This war was not fought only between armies. National Socialist Germany murdered six million European Jews. It murdered Sinti and Roma, people with disabilities, political opponents, prisoners of war and civilians in the countries it occupied, and it forced millions of people to work for it. Germany's allies and other states at war also committed grave crimes. Tens of millions of people died, more of them civilians than soldiers.
about.3: None of this is part of the play. The game does not show it, nothing can be gained from it, and no decision in the game asks you to take part in it. That is deliberate: these crimes are not material for a game. That they do not appear here does not mean that they did not happen or that they matter less than the battles.
about.4: The game uses no symbols, slogans, songs or speeches of the National Socialist or Fascist regimes. For that reason some flags and emblems are simplified and are not the historical ones.
sources.title: Where it comes from, and the licences
sources.1: The map is made from Natural Earth (naturalearthdata.com), which is in the public domain. The borders are those of 1 September 1939, from the treaties; nothing was traced from an atlas.
sources.2: The typeface is Jersey 10, Copyright 2023 The Soft Type Project Authors, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, drawn here as rows of pixels sampled from the font.

sources.4: This game collects nothing: it has no accounts, no network access and no tracking.
